scripts.build: npm run build:firefox && npm run build:chrome
scripts.package: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.sign: npm test && npm run check && npm run build:firefox && npm run lint:ext && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/web-ext/bin/web-ext.js sign --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts --channel unlisted
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run check && npm run build && npm run check:dist && npm run lint:ext && npm run e2e && npm run e2e:chrome-real
